title: Plex Media Server: 4 flaws used in attacks; attackers can reach systems behind it
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 45 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. Ready-made attack tools are public.

category.label: Other software
category.why: Software we have not put in a category yet. Your IT team or provider will know whether you run it.
category.doThis: Find out if you use it. If you do, apply the vendor's fix.

summary: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Oct 23, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
